verses.text: Early in the morning Joshua and all the people of Israel set out from Shittim and came to the Jordan. They camped there before crossing.
After three days the leaders went through the camp
and gave the people this order: "When you see the priests, the Levites, carrying the covenant box of the LORD your God, leave your places and follow it.
But keep a space of about a kilometre between you and the box. Do not go near it. Then you will know which way to go, because you have never been this way before."
Joshua told the people, "Make yourselves holy, because tomorrow the LORD will do amazing things among you."
Joshua told the priests, "Lift up the covenant box and go ahead of the people." So they lifted it up and went ahead of them.
The LORD said to Joshua, "Today I will begin to make you great in the eyes of all Israel, so they will know that I am with you just as I was with Moses.
Tell the priests carrying the covenant box, 'When you reach the edge of the Jordan's water, stand still in the river.'"
Joshua said to the people of Israel, "Come here and listen to the words of the LORD your God."

He said, "This is how you will know that the living God is among you, and that he will surely drive out the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites and Jebusites ahead of you.
Look, the covenant box of the Lord of all the earth is going ahead of you into the Jordan.
Now choose twelve men from the tribes of Israel, one from each tribe.
When the feet of the priests carrying the box of the LORD, the Lord of all the earth, touch the water of the Jordan, the water flowing down will stop and stand up in one heap."
So the people left their tents to cross the Jordan, with the priests carrying the covenant box ahead of them.
It was harvest time, when the Jordan overflows all its banks. As soon as the priests carrying the box reached the river and their feet touched the edge of the water,

the water coming down stopped flowing. It piled up in one heap far away, at the town of Adam near Zarethan. The water flowing down to the Dead Sea was completely cut off. So the people crossed over near Jericho.
The priests carrying the LORD's covenant box stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan, while all Israel crossed on dry ground, until the whole nation had crossed over.
